messages:
kai: Heads up — rack42 NIC tx queue depth spiking since 09:12 UTC. Fractional dedicated slices on that rack (d-pool-usw2-2) are seeing p95 token latency jump ~2-4x. Captured nic stats and a couple tcpdump snippets.
ops-bot: [ALERT] nic-saturation detected on rack42 at 2024-11-08T09:12:31Z - alert-id: nic-rack42-0x9af
mira: On it. Quick question — is impact limited to d-pool-usw2-2 or are shared tenants hitting it too?
kai: Primarily d-pool-usw2-2 and some shared neighbors that got scheduled onto the same ToR. Pattern looks like large checkpoint transfers + concurrent KV cache regen causing RDMA bursts.
jamal: Can we fast-path by preferring hosts with nvlink_health=good && nic_qdepth<2000 during new allocations? Might avoid placing fractional carveouts on saturated NICs.
lina: We don't have a hard block for fractional carveouts today. Proposal: temporary hold on new fractional allocations to rack42 and kick a warm-pool rebalance. Also consider bumping egress priority for dedicated slices (soft isolation).
raj: Note: rebalancing will cause warmups and some extra token generation during migration — cost impact measurable, but SLO > marginal cost here.
mira: Proposed plan: 1) pause new fractional allocations to rack42 (allocator change) 2) trigger warm-pool requeue for instances currently on rack42 3) enable egress-shielding flag `dedicated-strict` for 30m. I'll open a PR and rollout to canary.
kai: Quick commands I ran: ``kubectl exec -n allocator allocator-ctrl -- ./bin/allocate --filter 'rack!=rack42 && pool=d-pool-usw2-2' --dry-run`` and ``tc -s qdisc show dev eth0`` (attached excerpt). Also tail of syslogs shows DMA bursts around 09:11:57.
ops-bot: ops-bot: deploy job allocator/pause-fractional-rack42 started by mira - job id 0x9af - ETA ~2m
jamal: After the pause, we should watch KV miss rate and tail latencies closely. I'll wire a temporary Grafana panel for `/metrics/token_latency{pool="d-pool-usw2-2"}` and add an alert for p95>700ms.
lina: Filing vendor ticket — suspected NIC firmware/regression causing DMA burst aggregation on our switch. Ticket: NVNIC-2024-834. Adding :eyes:
kai: Update 09:20 UTC: allocator pause applied. New fractional carveouts to rack42 are blocked. Early numbers: p95 for affected tenants down from ~1200ms -> ~420ms. Continuing to monitor.
mira: PR: https://git.redwood/allocator/pull/312 — gating flag + rollout plan. Rolling to canary in 5m.
raj: Please tag cost entries with `emergency-egress-rebal` so finance can reconcile. We'll reconcile after 24h.
_comment: No title field as per agents.md; messages are a single continuous string with messages prefixed by sender names. Timestamps are plausible.
